"""Post-outcome reconstruction of native stage completion from retained charges."""
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
root=Path('target/actual-landing/v2/shared-armed-world1-p1-powered-probe')
probe=root/'actual-landing-probe.json';ledger=root/'live-planning.csv';dense=root/'capture-evidence.jsonl'
document=json.loads(probe.read_text())
starts={row['probe']['generation']:row['probe'] for row in document['rows']
    if row['probe'] and row['probe']['request_tick']==row['tick']}
thresholds={g:next(t for t in r['transitions'] if t['phase']=='full/ground/0') for g,r in starts.items()}
work={g:dict(graph=0,physics_queries=0) for g in starts};first={};previous={}
for row in csv.DictReader(ledger.open()):
    g=int(row['generation'])
    if row['task']!='landing_objective' or int(row['actor'])!=0 or g not in work:continue
    before=dict(work[g]);work[g]['graph']+=int(row['graph']);work[g]['physics_queries']+=int(row['queries'])
    if g not in first and all(work[g][k]>=thresholds[g]['work'][k] for k in work[g]):
        assert any(before[k]<thresholds[g]['work'][k] for k in before)
        first[g]=dict(generation=g,source_tick=starts[g]['request_tick'],
            detached_boundary=thresholds[g],dispatch_tick=int(row['tick']),
            cumulative_before=before,cumulative_after=dict(work[g]))
assert set(first)==set(starts)
wanted={r['dispatch_tick']+1:g for g,r in first.items()}
for line in dense.open():
    row=json.loads(line);tick=row['pilot']['tick']
    if row['seat']!=0 or tick not in wanted:continue
    g=wanted[tick];e=row['objective_evidence']
    assert e['generation']==g and e['request_tick']==starts[g]['request_tick']
    assert e['invalidated_by'] is None and row['landing_objective'] is None
    assert row['pilot']['landing']['phase']=='landed' and row['pilot']['transfer']=='ready'
    assert row['capture']['acquisition']['reason']=='actual_route_unavailable'
    first[g]['next_observation']=row
assert all('next_observation' in r for r in first.values())
result=dict(schema=1,scope=__doc__,
    derivation='Each copied job follows the same deterministic native step order and retained snapshot as its source request. The first live dispatch whose cumulative per-generation charges reach the detached full-ground boundary has completed the local attempt. This is a reconstructed dispatch boundary, not a newly logged native event and not a negative full-route certificate.',
    inputs={str(p):digest(p) for p in [probe,ledger,dense,Path(__file__)]},
    records=list(first.values()))
out=Path('docs/data/actual-landing-stage-timing-v2.json')
with out.open('x') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(out,digest(out))
for r in result['records']:
    print(r['generation'],r['source_tick'],r['dispatch_tick'],r['next_observation']['pilot']['tick'],
        r['detached_boundary']['measurements']['powered_corridor_failures'])
